description: Things side by side that read as one unit, at the group step: a mark beside a name, a label beside its badge, an icon and the word after it. Two elements side by side are already a row, however short the line, and each is where a display: flex with a gap of somebody's choosing gets written instead. arena-row--component is the step for things that are separate things, a bar's links or a toolbar's buttons. arena-row--start, arena-row--baseline and arena-row--between line the items up and carry no length. The row wraps when the line runs out. Write it on an element of yours: a component's own element may carry no box.
